notes: LOVE (love2d): a game is a .love zip, or on Windows a fused game.exe (love.exe with the .love appended) shipped beside love.dll, lua51.dll and SDL2.dll (https://love2d.org/wiki/Game_Distribution); an unpacked game is a folder whose main.lua runs and whose conf.lua defines love.conf (https://love2d.org/wiki/Config_Files). main.lua alone is not enough: other Lua runtimes use the same name, so the loose shape also needs love.conf. The LOVE version the game was written for is enrichment: love.dll's own version resource when the game ships the Windows runtime, else conf.lua's t.version. Enginehost plugin: dev.enginehost.love2d.11.v1 (LOVE 11.5).

saves.source: enginehost-love2d-plugin patch enginehost/patches/love/0001-enginehost-save-parent.patch (Filesystem::setIdentity: ENGINEHOST_LOVE_SAVE_PARENT/<identity>) and love/src/main/java/org/love2d/android/EngineHostGameActivity.java:151-154 (<save>/LOVE for a game, <save> for a fused one); the desktop's %APPDATA%/LOVE/<identity> and $XDG_DATA_HOME/love/<identity> are the patch's own comment
